question: vLLM V100 NVFP4 fallback dequantize FP16 kernel

sources.title: vllm/docs/features/quantization/modelopt.md at for-v100-fp16-patch ...
sources.snippet: On GPUs without a supported native FP4 GEMM kernel, vLLM falls back to weight-only (W4A16) execution via Marlin and logs a warning; this may reduce throughput for compute-heavy workloads. Use --linear-backend to override the automatic selection (this replaces the deprecated VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND environment variable).
